jobs.title: M&A Integrations Sr Project Manager
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is the global leader in Lean AI supply chains. By bringing together expert people, industry-leading technology, and a disciplined operating model, we take on some of the toughest supply chain challenges and continuously improve how we deliver for our customers.

We’re seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the integration of acquired businesses into our global enterprise. In this highly visible role, you’ll bring structure to complex integrations, aligning teams across the business to turn strategy into action, navigate change, and deliver lasting business value.

You’ll serve as a central point of coordination, building and executing integration plans, anticipating challenges, and continuously improving how we work. Along the way, you’ll partner with experts across the business, take on real responsibility, and help shape how we build what’s next at C.H. Robinson.

At C.H. Robinson, we believe collaboration plays an important role in how we solve complex problems and drive meaningful results. For this role, we have a preference for candidates located near our Eden Prairie, MN, or Chicago, IL offices, where there are opportunities for in-person connection and collaboration. However, we’re open to fully remote candidates and will prioritize finding the right person for the role.

Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:

Lead multiple, large-scale, and complex integration projects, translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and driving execution across cross-functional teams
Own critical project documentation, including project charters, plans, process flows and value stream maps, resource requirements, and business cases
Bring together internal and external stakeholders around shared priorities, deliverables, dependencies, and decisions, building trust through clear and consistent communication
Drive projects forward to deliver quality solutions on time and within budget, taking ownership of outcomes, proactively identifying risks, resolving issues, and escalating when appropriate
Lead teams through change by influencing without direct authority, welcoming different perspectives, and constructively challenging the status quo to achieve stronger outcomes
Track, manage, and communicate project progress and financial performance, including resource requirements, budget-to-actual performance, key milestones, and project outcomes
Apply a continuous improvement and builder mindset to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and strengthen the tools, processes, and ways of working that support successful integrations
Partner with experts across the business to transfer knowledge, strengthen organizational capabilities, and mentor project team members
Lead Robinson Operating Model (ROM) projects internally to advance our lean operating model

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
Minimum 5 years of project management experience, with the proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to work flexible hours (some weekend/late hours may be required)

Preferred Qualifications:

Project Management Professional certification
Work and/or project experience in Supply Chain, Transportation, and/or Logistics
Strong communication skills: strong listener with exceptional facilitation skills and the ability to tell the story and connect to your audience
Ability to organize, design, develop, and deliver projects for internal and external audiences at all levels
Ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts internally and externally at all levels
Experience working and thriving in a continuous improvement environment
Experience and comfort in dealing with ambiguity and able to deliver with minimal oversight
Experience working directly with customers
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs
Experience with lean processes and tools
Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

Compensation Range

$77,000.00 - $173,600.00

The base pay range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by work location, which takes into account geographic cost of labor, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base pay only and do not include additional variable compensation.

Questioning if you meet the mark? Studies have shown that some individuals may be less likely to apply unless they match the job description exactly. Here at C.H. Robinson, we’re building an inclusive workplace where all employees feel they belong. If this position excites you, we welcome you to apply whether you check all the preferred qualifications or just a few. You may just be our next great fit!

Equal Opportunity

C.H. Robinson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a workplace and performance culture that reflects the strengths of our worldwide marketplace. We value unique experiences and diverse backgrounds of our people within our company, our business relationships, and our communities. We’re committed to providing an inclusive environment, free from harassment and discrimination, where all employees feel welcomed, valued and respected.

Your Health, Wealth and Self

Your total wellbeing is the foundation of our business, and our benefits support your financial, family and personal goals. We provide the top-tier benefits that matter to you most, including:

jobs.title: Project Manager (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
FYI - For Your Information, Inc.
is an SBA certified, Woman-Owned Small Business and GSA schedule holder that is a premier provider of Human Capital, Training, and Information Technology services. We have won awards for being a Great Place to Work and continue to make ground-breaking advancements. For four years in a row, we have been on Inc. Magazine's 5000 list and were recently named one of Inc.'s 2024 Mid-Atlantic Fastest Growing companies.

Position is contingent upon contract award.

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with at least eight years of federal HR operations project management experience to serve as the single point of contact overseeing all aspects of contract performance, staffing, and service delivery. The ideal candidate manages milestones, budgets, risk, and quality assurance while coordinating closely with Government CORs and program leadership to ensure compliance with federal regulations, contract requirements, and performance expectations across all workstreams.

Responsibilities

Provide comprehensive contract reporting, including status reports, performance metrics, risk updates, and staffing summaries to the Government on a recurring basis.
Address Government concerns promptly, ensuring all questions, issues, and requests for information are acknowledged, analyzed, and resolved in a timely, professional manner.
Manage milestones and deadlines across all workstreams to ensure timely delivery of contract requirements and fulfillment of all performance obligations.
Serve as the single point of contact (POC) for communicating staffing changes, onboarding timelines, and impacts to service delivery or operational efficiency.
Oversee budget management, tracking expenditures, forecasting future resource needs, and ensuring alignment with contract funding and limitations.
Develop and maintain the project management plan, documenting scope, schedule, risks, quality controls, and communication strategies that guide daily operations.
Coordinate closely with Government CORs and program leadership, ensuring alignment on priorities, expectations, and interpretation of contract requirements.
Monitor vendor staff performance, validating qualifications, ensuring coverage for all functional areas, and addressing performance issues that may affect service quality.
Implement risk management practices, identifying potential risks to delivery, maintaining a risk register, and proactively proposing mitigation strategies.
Ensure compliance with federal regulations, HR policy requirements, agency-specific procedures, and contract terms throughout all service areas.
Facilitate issue resolution across systems and processes, partnering with Government stakeholders and vendor technical experts to troubleshoot and resolve operational challenges.
Oversee quality assurance and quality control, ensuring all work products meet required standards, performance measures, and service level expectations.
Manage change control processes, documenting, assessing, and coordinating Government approval for scope changes, staffing adjustments, or revised workflows.
Lead regular status meetings, prepare agendas, track action items, and ensure effective communication between vendor teams and Government personnel.
Support transition planning, including transition-in and transition-out activities, ensuring continuity of operations and documenting institutional knowledge as required.

Required

Three to five years of experience providing independent HR support and services in any HR functional area (e.g. staffing, classification, employee benefits, employee relations, information systems, policy development); experience serving as a project lead, collaborating with others to effectively implement the project objectives.
Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in managing projects directly relating to Federal Human Resources Operations.
Minimum of Five (5) years of supervisory experience, in a lead or management role, with a demonstrated success in the ability to staff and lead/manage technically oriented projects and personnel. Experience in formulating work standards, assigning contractor schedules and resources, reviewing performance, cost, and budget information; supervising contractor personnel; and communicating policies, purposes, and goals of the organization to subordinates.

FYI's Benefits/Incentives: What is in it for you?

Opportunity to work a hybrid work schedule
A knowledgeable, high-achieving, diverse, experienced, and fun team.
The chance to be part of a rapidly growing company and the next success story.
A competitive base salary with a loaded benefits package plus 401K.
Tuition/education assistance, personal computer allowance, pet insurance.

TASK ORDER PROJECT MANAGER

At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. B&A is seeking a Task Order Project Manager
to support the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) EAGLE IT Sustainment Support. The primary place of performance will be at the contractor’s place of performance and/or Off-Site.

Remote

jobs.title: Principal IT Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

About The Role

A Principal IT Security Project Manager
leads complex, enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives and manages strategic security programs from planning to completion. As a SaaS provider, Bullhorn’s security posture is critical to our customers' continued success. This role will be part of the Information Security vertical, reporting directly to the CISO.

A Typical Day Will Include...

Program Leadership: Direct large-scale cross-functional security projects, such as large scale software hardening, identity management rollouts, cloud security implementations, or zero-trust implementations.
Risk Management: Identify project risks, track vulnerabilities, and build mitigation plans to protect business assets.
Stakeholder Management: Communicate project progress, budgets, and security metrics clearly to executive leadership and technical teams. Ability to present progress in both concise headlines and detailed technical detail.
Resource Allocation: Manage solution planning calls, team workloads, and identifying budget issues/needs.
Compliance Alignment: Ensure all project milestones meet regulatory standards where applicable (SOC 2, ISO 27001)

This Role Is a Fit for You If...

Experience: You have 8+ years of IT project management experience, with at least 5 years focused specifically on cybersecurity or information security.
Education: You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Business, or a related field.
Certifications: You have a PMP (Project Management Professional) and a security credential like CISSP, CISM, or CRISC.
Technical Knowledge: You have a deep understanding of network security, endpoint protection, threat intelligence, and security frameworks.
Leadership: You have a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Communication: You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills for translating technical security risks into business language.
Work Style: You are comfortable being self motivated and working independently. Ability to work seamlessly with executives and engineers as needed.

The annual base salary range for this position is $144,000 - $170,000. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus & a comprehensive benefits package.

Compensation And Transparency Statement

The posted range represents the good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request.

What We Offer...

Benefits eligibility effective DAY ONE including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), 401(k) Match, and more
Unlimited Planned Paid Time Off
Global Mental Health Support
On-Demand Learning & Development
Quarterly paid volunteer days
Lucrative Employee Referral Program (eligible for prior to your first day)
Company-wide mentor program

Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

We are a people-first culture where everyone’s contribution is valued and respected. We're looking for smart, forward-thinking individuals who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to the table. You will work on challenging assignments from individual projects, large projects, major programs, to large scale engineering only, Engineer Procure and EPC projects.
Direct the team leads in the coordination of detailed design phases for all aspects of engineering, design, and construction support.
Lead efforts to ensure projects are completed satisfactorily, with high quality, on time performance and to strict financial requirements.
Coordinate systems design activities to ensure installation and operations will comply with specifications, codes, and client requirements.
Prepare reports and studies that present technical information in a clear and concise manner and meet client requirements and Sargent & Lundy formats.
Perform and provide independent reviews of work performed by others, including scopes of work, proposals, procurement specifications, and contract documents.

This position is expected to start remote with the expectation to work on a hybrid work schedule once the Boise, ID office is opened.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Power Delivery - Remote
jobs.description:
Job Description

WSP is seeking a Project Manager for our Power Delivery Project Management team located in Rochester, NY; Syracuse, NY; New York City, NY; Boston, MA; Portland, ME; or Newark, NJ.

The candidate may work from a mutually acceptable location within the region and must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face-to-face meetings. The successful candidate will be responsible for initiating and executing Power Delivery projects, managing and developing client relationships, and marketing WSP’s Power Delivery services to existing and new clients in the respective region.

This Opportunity

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide PM leadership for small/medium/large scale/more complex high voltage and high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects ensuring support for preparing and overseeing project detailed design, budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs, monitoring external events and risk contingencies, ensuring satisfactory performance, and managing the contractual obligations to deliver the project or assigned portfolio of assigned project(s) as defined in the contract and client’s expectations.
Develop and foster effective strategies to engage project stakeholders at all levels, maintain effective relationships, and report on project progress.
Provide guidance with pursuit/initiation activities for projects meeting defined criteria or risk profile; including “Go / No-Go” decisions, contract reviews, risk mitigation strategies, pricing reviews, etc.
May participate, and at times, lead the contract negotiations and client presentations
Actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan.
Provide verbal and/or written inputs to multi-disciplinary project teams and contribute to providing high level strategic advice to clients.
Provide guidance and mentoring to other staff.
Ensure updates occur with system and process documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan where applicable.
Lead project kick-off meetings with key stakeholders.
Coordinate with area/technical managers to address project resource and subcontracting requirements in a timely manner.
Maintain regular communications with the client including reporting on monthly status, safety incidents, and major issues together with scope and budget impacts.
Participate in and oversee problem project reviews, providing input about root cause issues and potential solutions. Assist with developing project recovery plans.
Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.
Complete formal project closeout activities, along with facilitating and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

We are seeking enthusiastic Project Managers to join our expanding Rail Engineering Services team to lead on the management and delivery of our diverse portfolio of rail engineering projects across the UK and overseas.

Provide clients with technical excellence through our delivery of projects.

Work-life balance

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
As a TPM for SRE, you will partner with SRE leaders and engineers to scale the platform that underpins all of MongoDB’s cloud products. You will drive program execution, strengthen production reliability practices, and coordinate cross-functional efforts across US and EMEA teams. Success in this role means smoother launches, clearer roadmaps, stronger reliability metrics and an SRE organization that's better-equipped to deliver predictability at scale.

This role can be based out of our Dublin or Cork office or remotely in Ireland.

What You'll Do

Drive Program Planning & Execution – Define program scope, milestones, and success criteria with SRE engineers and leaders. Manage dependencies across platform teams, keep work clearly tracked in Jira, and deliver on time
Strengthen Production Reliability – Lead change management and launch readiness programs. Partner with SREs and product teams to define and operationalize SLOs/SLIs, and use incident data, metrics, and capacity signals to drive prioritization and continuous improvement
Lead Cross-Functional Coordination – Align SRE with Security, Compliance, Cloud platform, and other engineering teams. Coordinate cross-team incident response, ensure clear follow-through, and build trust as the go-to driver of complex, multi-team efforts
Build Scalable Systems & Processes – Design lightweight frameworks and communication patterns that help SRE deliver reliably at scale. Work yourself out of the "hero" role by leaving teams better-equipped to execute independently

Requirements

8+ years in technical program management, engineering management, or a comparable technical role partnering with software engineering teams
Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-team platform initiatives through ambiguity and change
Strong knowledge of production change management, software development lifecycle, and reliability metrics (SLOs, SLIs)
Skilled at shaping roadmaps and managing dependencies
Able to query and interpret metrics, logs, or other data sources to inform decisions and communicate risk
Excellent communicator—clear, concise, and calm—across engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives
Low-ego, highly collaborative, and motivated by ownership of hard problems end to end

Nice to Have

Hands-on or close-partner experience with Kubernetes, cloud networking, or observability stacks (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting)
Prior experience working with or alongside SRE teams
Background in large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform engineering
Familiarity with MongoDB Atlas or other modern cloud database platforms

Why This Role

This role puts MongoDB's values into practice. You'll own hard, ambiguous problems end to end. You'll build together with SRE, engineering, Security, and Compliance to co-create solutions that work across the organization. And you'll think big—scaling the platform and practices that power MongoDB's next phase of growth. You'll be in the critical path of high-impact projects, working with executive stakeholders, and supported to grow in your career.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Position Overview

Natural Resources National Service Line Program Manager

Shape the Future of Natural Resources Consulting

EA Engineering, Science, and Technology, Inc., PBC (EA) is seeking an accomplished environmental leader to serve as our Natural Resources National Service Line Program Manager
. This is a unique opportunity to influence the strategic direction and continued growth of one of the nation's leading environmental consulting firms while partnering with clients to solve some of today's most complex natural resource challenges.

As a senior leader within EA's Corporate Client Programs, you will help define national growth strategies, cultivate executive-level client relationships, lead pursuit and capture efforts for high-profile opportunities, and work alongside technical and operational leaders to expand EA's presence across public and private markets. This role is ideal for an established professional who combines technical credibility with exceptional business acumen and is passionate about building lasting client partnerships, mentoring future leaders, and growing a nationally recognized practice.

If you have a proven record of developing business, leading multidisciplinary teams, and helping clients navigate complex environmental challenges, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of natural resources consulting.

What You'll Do

Lead Strategic Growth

Develop and execute national growth strategies that strengthen EA's Natural Resources practice and align with corporate priorities.
Identify emerging market opportunities and position EA for success across federal, state, local, private, and NGO sectors.
Drive strategic pursuit planning, competitive positioning, and market expansion initiatives that increase our visibility and market share.
Build long-term relationships with key clients, agency leaders, industry partners, and professional organizations.

Serve as a Trusted Client Advisor

Develop executive-level relationships with strategic clients, becoming a trusted advisor on their most important environmental initiatives.
Collaborate with business unit leaders and technical experts to develop innovative, practical solutions that address complex client needs.
Represent EA at industry conferences, professional organizations, and client events, expanding our national presence and reputation.
Lead client engagement, capture strategy, and teaming discussions for significant opportunities.

Guide project scoping, pricing strategy, risk assessment, and technical solution development.

Foster strategic partnerships that expand EA's capabilities and create new business opportunities.

At EA, you'll join a purpose-driven organization committed to solving today's most pressing environmental challenges. jobs.title: AI Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position

Company : Liberty Mutual Insurance

Location : Columbus, Ohio

Posted On : 10/9/2026

Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, Boston, MA, Plano, TX, Indianapolis, IN and Columbus, OH.

You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. We will not sponsor employment visas. Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.

Job Introduction

Liberty Mutual Technology's Global Digital Services organization is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead program delivery for the AI Backbone, Liberty Mutual's shared enterprise foundation for AI. This role will focus on driving alignment, execution, and adoption across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders as the organization continues to expand and mature AI capabilities across the enterprise.

About The AI Backbone

The AI Backbone provides the shared capabilities, standards, and reusable services that enable teams across Liberty Mutual to build and deploy AI solutions consistently, securely, and efficiently. Rather than having individual teams create their own approaches to security, governance, observability, identity, and AI operations, the Backbone establishes a common foundation that accelerates delivery while reducing complexity and risk.

Supporting a broad spectrum of AI use cases, from generative AI applications to advanced agentic systems, the Backbone is designed to evolve alongside the rapidly changing AI landscape. It brings together shared technical capabilities, enterprise platforms, governance, and delivery partnerships to accelerate innovation, reduce risk, and enable AI adoption across Liberty Mutual.

The Role of this Technical Program Manager

The TPM joining this program will play a pivotal role in helping Liberty Mutual realize the full potential of AI as an enterprise capability. Working across a diverse ecosystem of technology, data, security, architecture, finance, and business stakeholders, this leader will drive alignment around shared priorities, informed decision-making, and the successful adoption of the capabilities, standards, and operating models that enable AI at scale.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence how Liberty Mutual scales and governs AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will bring clarity and momentum to a rapidly evolving landscape, helping leaders make informed decisions while aligning efforts across teams, platforms, and strategic initiatives.

Success in this role requires exceptional program leadership, strong executive presence, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with technical curiosity and is comfortable engaging leaders across engineering, security, architecture, data, and business domains to translate enterprise AI strategy into coordinated action and measurable outcomes.

About The Job

This role is responsible for coordinating the planning, governance, and execution required to advance the AI Backbone and enable consistent adoption of shared AI capabilities across Liberty Mutual. The TPM will bring together stakeholders across technology and business domains, helping leaders make informed decisions, manage dependencies, and translate strategic priorities into measurable outcomes.

Strategic Planning and Execution: Develop and own the multi-year AI Backbone roadmap (Now / Next / Later), sequencing work across shared capabilities, contributing teams, and strategic initiatives. Define target outcomes, phase milestones, and readiness criteria while adapting plans as technologies, priorities, and enterprise needs evolve. Guide the evolution of the Backbone operating model from managed reuse toward federated adoption. Maintain an integrated program plan and delivery rhythm across workstreams, actively managing dependency health, milestone slippage, and re-sequencing as conditions change.
Enterprise Leadership and Alignment: Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, and decision forums spanning Global Digital Services (GDS), Global Cyber Security (GCS), Enterprise Data & Data Science (ED&DS), Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Observability, Finance, and lighthouse delivery teams. Foster shared accountability without direct reporting authority and establish consistent planning, reporting, and governance practices across participating teams. Set the execution quality bar for program and project leads working on AI initiatives across domains, and coach them toward consistent planning, risk, and reporting practices.
Vendor Management: Coordinate strategic technology partners including AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Datadog, and Zscaler across evaluation, commitment, and scale-out decisions. Ensure build, buy, and partner strategies align with enterprise priorities, timelines, commercial objectives, and quality expectations.
Enterprise Adoption and Enablement: Drive adoption of shared AI capabilities, approved patterns, and production-readiness standards across teams with varying priorities, business needs, and risk profiles. Partner across the organization to promote consistent approaches to AI delivery while establishing governance mechanisms that support long-term adoption and scale.
Risk Management: Proactively identify systemic and cross-program risks spanning identity, governance, model risk, data access, security, and cost. Partner with GCS, ED&DS, LibertyAIR, Enterprise Architecture, and other stakeholders to address risks before they become barriers to adoption or scale. Maintain an enterprise view of risk and dependency health across the AI Backbone portfolio.
Communication: Serve as the primary author and presenter of AI Backbone updates for Tech ELT, SLT, and business leadership. Translate complex technical concepts, program progress, tradeoffs, and investment decisions into clear, decision-oriented communications and executive-level narratives, including progress-to-goal, decisions required, and risks surfaced ahead of impact.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and mature the Backbone operating model, reducing manual effort associated with onboarding, readiness assessment, governance, and reporting. Capture lessons learned and emerging best practices and incorporate them into reusable patterns, standards, and operating rhythms.

Additional Responsibilities Specific To This Role

Portfolio Governance: Design and operate the governance model for the AI Backbone, including decision frameworks, escalation paths, production-readiness criteria, ownership models, and executive scorecards. Shift governance discussions from status reporting to informed decision-making.
Dependency and Ownership Management: Build and maintain visibility into dependencies across shared capabilities, strategic AI initiatives, and underlying enterprise platforms. Maintain an inventory of AI and agentic initiatives, track maturity and readiness, and help resolve ownership ambiguity across teams and domains.
Financial and Investment Management: Partner with Technology & Enterprise Finance and Strategy & Transformation to support AI FinOps, investment planning, capacity management, funding requests, and value realization metrics. Provide leaders with the information needed to make informed investment decisions and prioritize resources effectively.
Technical Judgment and Architecture Engagement: Participate in architecture and design forums to understand tradeoffs across shared capabilities and platforms, and use that understanding to inform sequencing, readiness criteria, and risk assessment.

Scope of Ownership

Role

This position is leveled above the standard Technical Program Manager role based on enterprise scope, stakeholder altitude, and the structural nature of the decisions it drives:

Enterprise-wide scope. This role oversees a portfolio of shared capabilities, strategic AI initiatives, and the operating model that connects them, spanning multiple technology and business domains.
Strategic decisions, not execution-level tradeoffs. In partnership with leadership and product teams, this TPM influences priorities, sequencing, investment direction, escalation decisions, and enterprise readiness standards that shape how AI capabilities are delivered and adopted.
Complex problems with evolving solutions. AI technologies, operating models, and ownership boundaries continue to evolve. The role must bring structure to ambiguity, frame complex cross-organizational challenges, and guide stakeholders toward aligned decisions.
Manages by exception. Intervenes based on program-level impact rather than task-level detail, letting capability and lighthouse teams own their execution while maintaining visibility into decisions, dependencies, and risks.
Executive engagement. The role regularly advises and is accountable to Liberty Mutual's senior technology leaders and is responsible for providing clear, actionable insights that inform strategy, prioritization, and investment decisions.
Impact through influence. Success is measured by alignment across stakeholders, consistency of execution, and the overall health and adoption of the AI Backbone, measured through adoption, readiness, and stakeholder confidence metrics rather than the delivery of any single workstream.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 12+ years of technical program management, enterprise transformation, or implementation consulting experience, including 5+ years leading multi-organization, multi-year technology programs in an agile environment.
Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise platform, shared-services, or foundational capability program (e.g., cloud platform, data platform, identity, developer enablement, or AI/ML platform) where success depended on adoption by teams outside your reporting line.
Working technical fluency in modern AI and agentic architectures: LLM access and model gateways, agent runtimes and orchestration, memory and semantic layers, evaluation and observability, and identity and governance controls. Familiarity with AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, Databricks / MLflow, Snowflake, Azure Entra ID, Datadog, and MCP / A2A interoperability standards is strongly preferred.
Proven experience establishing portfolio governance decision forums, readiness criteria, RACI, escalation frameworks and executive scorecards across organizations that do not report to you.
Track record of regular, high-quality communication with C-level and ELT-level technology leadership, including structuring options and investment asks and driving decisions in contentious settings.
Experience with technology financial management: FinOps, rent / buy / build economics, business cases, capacity planning and value realization tracking.
Demonstrated leadership of organizational change in large technology organizations, moving teams from local autonomy toward shared standards while preserving delivery velocity.
Exception

We are seeking enthusiastic Project Managers to join our expanding Rail Engineering Services team to lead on the management and delivery of our diverse portfolio of rail engineering projects across the UK and overseas.

Lead, direct, and coordinate multi-disciplinary technical teams, being accountable to the Client for project delivery;

Work alongside Engineering and Design Managers to ensure the technical delivery of Rail projects;
Set an example for health, safety and welfare on your projects and instil a strong safety culture within the delivery team;
Lead and contribute to the development of high performing teams from multiple technical disciplines and specialisms (including subconsultants);

You will work on exciting and inspiring projects for a variety of infrastructure owners, national and local governments, public and private sector clients including Network Rail, HS2, regional transport bodies, operators and contractors. Undertake work across the full project lifecycle, from early concept stage to detailed design and subsequently supporting delivery contractors on site;
Mentor others in the team, supporting their development by sharing knowledge and experience;

An ability to manage multiple workstreams and teams, balancing priorities, making value and delivery judgements / decisions to meet or exceed our client’s expectations;

Degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline and demonstrable pathway to chartership;

Experience across the full project lifecycle from initial feasibility studies to detailed design and implementation;
A track record of mentoring and developing staff.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the Tean
US Data Security (USDS) Joint Venture (JV) provides industry-leading security and privacy services to US users and supports TikTok Global. Our organization uses four principles that guide our operations. Firstly, we champion trust and transparency, leading the charge that drives customer confidence. Secondly, we are an engine of innovation. Thirdly, we drive risk-informed and empowered decision-making, giving our business leaders the information needed to make key decisions. Finally, we proactively identify and reduce risk while enabling innovative product development – to consistently build sustainable world-class security capabilities.

About the Role
As a member of the Influence Operations Intelligence & Discovery (IOID) Team, the candidate will leverage strategic geopolitical expertise and tactical knowledge of influence operations to identify trends and tradecraft of Advanced Persistent Manipulators (APMs) to drive action and response, unveil command and control (C2) elements, and document adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). The candidate must be able to use formal intelligence and incident response best practices to develop tracking and documentation of identified APMs. The candidate must have expert threat management skills including identification, prioritization, treatment, classification, and monitoring. The candidate must have excellent written and verbal communications skills for developing and briefing intelligence products for cross-functional teams and leadership as appropriate. Further, the candidate is expected to use communication skills to work closely with cross-functional partners in response to actions across a variety of security disciplines to disseminate information and reporting as appropriate in support of TikTok's critical business and operational needs.

Responsibilities:
- Possess geopolitical expertise in areas of responsibility to accurately trend IO and adversary strategic objectives
- Conduct OSINT monitoring and research to identify off-platform trends
- Uncover, record, and map adversary trends and tradecraft
- Maintain tools needed for tracking and memorialization of adversary actions and IO campaigns
- Respond to escalated events and actions when needed
- Develop intelligence reporting on hunting and investigation findings

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional experience, Proven track record of acquiring, aggregating, analyzing, and reporting on complex datasets. Expertise in open-source intelligence (OSINT) collection, tradecraft, and intelligence reporting.
- Experience designing, optimizing, and executing operational workflows within fast-paced technical environments. Ability to evaluate, prioritize, and mitigate critical business risks in real-time high-stress scenarios.
- Demonstrated ability to proactively hunt for diverse types of high-risk activity, including "unknown unknowns." Rigorous analytical and critical-thinking skills with a high degree of attention to detail.
- Deep understanding of information warfare principles and comprehensive knowledge of modern information warfare history over the past decade. Firm grasp of adversary TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures) with the ability to apply an adversarial lens to counter platform abuse.
- Hands-on experience detecting, tracking, and dissecting influence operations, disinformation, and other forms of social media manipulation. Ability to think creatively and identify previously unknown threats, vulnerabilities, and risks, while driving cross-functional stakeholder buy-in to implement strategic change.
- Measurable knowledge/experience from proven industry, military, defense, or government operations and/or bachelor’s degree in security (including cyber security), political science, and/or computer science or equivalent information security, privacy, risk, compliance, project management or similar discipline from an accredited college or university.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional experience in threat intelligence, security operations, data analysis, or a related domain
- Experience identifying, tracking, and analyzing adversary tradecraft and behavioral tactics.
- Proven track record of conducting threat actor attribution and campaign mapping. Experience translating adversary tradecraft into detection logic and developing automated detection rules.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a history of collaborating across global, multi-functional teams and intelligence partners. Experience authoring and disseminating intelligence reports tailored for both technical practitioners and leadership.
- Deep knowledge of threat intelligence platforms, data feeds, and open/closed intelligence sources.Excellent time management, prioritization, negotiation, and interpersonal skills in high-tempo environments.
- Self-motivated to drive results and scale security capabilities within a complex enterprise environment. Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large, complex data sets.
- Hands-on experience leveraging graph analysis tools to map threat actor infrastructure and entity relationships. Experience developing AI agents and designing innovative AI-driven solutions for threat intelligence workflows.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​

When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Profile

Lab and Research Specialist 2

Job Family

Lab and Research Support

Time Type

Full time

Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date.

Minimum Qualifications

Associate's degree and one (1) year of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.

Job Description

The Center for Violence Prevention and Community Safety is seeking a Research Analyst to support applied research, public health data analysis, data reporting, and research dissemination activities. The position will play a central role in maintaining and improving research data systems, producing data reports for internal and external partners, supporting dashboard development, and helping translate complex data into accessible products for academic, practitioner, policy, and general audiences.

Under administrative direction, provides assistance in developing, maintaining, and analyzing information and information systems for decisions based on key findings of research initiatives. This function involves considerable interaction and communication with management of units throughout the university, external agencies, and public and private sector representatives. The position requires strong attention to detail, comfort working with multiple datasets, and the ability to work independently while supporting the broader research mission of the Center.

Please provide a cover letter. Applications for which the cover letter does not include this information as specified will not be considered. This position is an in-person position and may be considered for hybrid/remote work opportunities.

Salary Range:
$48, 600 - $59,378 per year; DOE

Essential Duties

Data, Reporting and Research Support:

Updates, maintains, and improves data dashboards using R and related tools.
Provides technical support for applied research projects, public health data reporting, dashboard maintenance, and data dissemination, and coordinating research-related data products, reports, and internal process improvements.
Produces reports using VDRS/SUDORS and other project-related datasets in response to internal, partner, and stakeholder requests.
Coordinates the development of data for special management, policy studies and/or research activities.
Maintains the Center’s website.
Provides bi-weekly, monthly, and quarterly departmental reports and annual progress reports for research projects.
Develops recurring and ad hoc data summaries, tables, figures, and written summaries for project teams, Center leadership, and external partners.
Analyzes developments in the industry; remains current regarding significant developments and/or initiatives occurring.
Designs, coordinates, and conducts research activities and statistical studies.
Develops and maintains databases used to generate information for management decision making and evaluation of programs.
Links, cleans, wrangles, and summarizes multiple datasets to support research, evaluation, and reporting needs.
Participates on project teams in special studies resulting in recommending solutions or alternatives.
Identifies opportunities to streamline internal processes, reduce duplication of effort, improve data workflows, and increase efficiency across Center projects.
Helps train staff in the use of departmental data processing tools.
Creates and maintains databases utilizing various computer programming languages or user-oriented software, including Python, WordPress, Microsoft Excel, R, R Quarto, and R Shiny.
Uses Microsoft Excel and R to organize, analyze, summarize, visualize, and report data.
Utilizes statistical methods to analyze management problems and/or policy implications; assists evaluators in the development of measurement tools.
Applies basic statistical and data analysis techniques to support research, evaluation, public health surveillance, and violence-prevention projects.
Performs independent studies, internet and library searches on relevant subjects.
Generates and executes ideas for data dissemination products, including briefs, dashboards, reports, data summaries, visualizations, and other products designed for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Writes about technical subject matter for academic, practitioner, policy, and general audiences.
Makes recommendations to management, public/private sector representatives, and external constituencies.
May assist university departments by providing information for operational and strategic plans, or accreditation reviews.
Establishes and maintains office-based technology systems to aid in the effective administration of projects and activities.
May perform or assist in the delivery of presentations, write articles and technical reports.

Desired Qualifications

Master's degree in a related field AND one year of experience in research, information analysis or program evaluation; OR, any equivalent combination of education and/or experience from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.
Knowledge of the principles, practices and techniques of research design, methodologies, and statistics.
Knowledge of basic statistics and data analysis
Knowledge of statistical modeling is beneficial.
Knowledge of public health, epidemiology, violence prevention, injury surveillance, or related applied research areas is beneficial.
Knowledge of state and federal government agencies related to research funding process and regulations.
Knowledge of academic research environment.
Knowledge of grant writing and grant application procedures.
Knowledge of data collection and analysis methods, techniques, procedures.
Knowledge of statistical and financial tools.
Skill in effective communication, both written and verbal.
Skill in writing about technical subject matter for academic and general audiences.
Skill in data processing systems and applications
Skill in linking, cleaning, wrangling, summarizing, and documenting multiple datasets.
Skill in preparing and summarizing data for management reports and policy decisions.
Skill in using software and tools for data analysis, especially Microsoft Excel and R.
Skill in creating tables, charts, dashboards, reports, and other data dissemination products.
Skill in facilitating research partnerships.
Ability to understand broad issues.
Ability to apply advanced knowledge of the principles, practices and methods of internet-based research.
Ability to be detail oriented, accurate, and careful when working with data, reports, and public-facing products.
Ability to learn new software, analytic techniques, datasets, and subject matter as project needs evolve.
Ability to work independently, define tasks, manage competing priorities, and move projects forward with limited supervision.
Ability to translate technical findings into clear language for researchers, practitioners, community partners, policymakers, and the public.

Working Environment

Activities are performed in an environmentally controlled office setting subject to extended periods of sitting, keyboarding and manipulating a computer mouse (75%); required to stand for varying lengths of time and walk moderate distances to perform work (10%). Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, pushing and pulling up to 25 pounds (15%).Regular activities require ability to quickly change priorities, which may include and/or are subject to resolution of conflicts. Evidence of effective communication skills.

Department Statement

Toward the goal of social embeddedness, Arizona State University established the Center for Violence Prevention and Community Safety in July 2005 to respond to the growing need of Arizona's communities to improve the public's safety and well-being. The Center for Violence Prevention and Community Safety is a research unit within the College of Public Programs at Arizona State University.

The Center's mission is to generate, share, and apply quality research and knowledge to create "best practice" standards.

The Center specifically evaluates policies and programs, analyzes and evaluates patterns and causes of violence, develops strategies and programs, develops a clearinghouse of research reports and "best practice" models, educates, trains, and provides technical assistance, and facilitates the development of and construction of databases. The Center also supports public health and violence-prevention research through data analysis, dashboard development, research reporting, and dissemination products designed to inform policy, practice, and community safety strategies.

Driving Requirement

Driving is not required for this position.

Location:

Campus: Downtown Phoenix

Arizona State University is a new model for American higher education, an unprecedented combination of academic excellence, entrepreneurial energy and broad access. This New American University is a single, unified institution comprising four differentiated campuses positively impacting the economic, social, cultural and environmental health of the communities it serves. Its research is inspired by real world application blurring the boundaries that traditionally separate academic disciplines. Apply on Official Website About the Role

Nesa Software's Data Analyst works across the company's data stack, moving records between source systems, cleaning them, modeling them for reporting, and publishing dashboards that operations, sales, and finance teams rely on daily. The position expects hands-on ownership of pipelines end to end, not report authoring on someone else's data warehouse.
Day-to-day responsibilities include:
Designing and maintaining ETL and ELT pipelines that move data across multiple source and destination systems
Managing several database instances at once, keeping schemas consistent and loads reliable
Cleaning and transforming raw data so downstream reports and dashboards stay trustworthy
Building Power BI dashboards for stakeholders, using DAX and Power Query for the data model
Automating repetitive workflows with Power Automate and light scripting
Providing analysis that helps business teams make specific decisions rather than abstract observations

What You'll Need

The employer expects 3+ years of work as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, with proof of ownership on real pipelines. Required capabilities:
Advanced SQL, including query tuning and complex joins across normalized schemas
ETL and ELT pipeline development, with a working understanding of orchestration and error handling
Power BI and Power Query for report modeling, plus DAX for measures
Advanced Excel including pivot tables, lookups, and dashboarding
Data validation, quality checks, and basic data governance practices
Automation with Power Automate and scripting for glue work between systems

Salary and Benefits

Monthly pay ranges from INR 30,000 to INR 40,000 based on experience and interview outcome. Benefits include provident fund contributions and health insurance. The position is full-time and permanent, not contract or gig.
Why Kochi's Infopark

Infopark Kakkanad is Kochi's flagship IT park, hosting more than 500 companies across software, product engineering, and IT services. Responsibilities

About the team:
TikTok Business Integrity is committed to ensuring a safe, trusted, and sustainable advertising ecosystem, serving as a core enabler of TikTok's global monetization growth. The team sits within Global Monetization Product and Technology (GMPT) – Business Integrity – Governance.
We focus on advertising content quality and user experience, driving governance of risks such as misleading claims, vulgar or disturbing content, and other low-quality content. Our mission is to build a scalable, intelligent, and data-driven risk governance system that achieves the optimal balance between risk control and user/advertiser experience in a highly dynamic global environment.
As we evolve, the team is accelerating toward a more platformized, intelligent, and automated governance system, leveraging AI Agents, machine learning models, and strategy frameworks to enable scalable, global impact.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly analytical and impact-driven Ads Content Risk Strategy Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be deeply involved in safeguarding TikTok's advertising ecosystem by identifying and solving key user experience and content quality challenges through data-driven insights and strategy design.
You will operate in a highly complex and global-scale environment, making strategic trade-offs across risk control, user experience, and business growth, while continuously improving the overall health of the advertising ecosystem.
You will also contribute to building the next-generation intelligent governance system, leveraging AI, machine learning models, and automation capabilities to transform governance from experience-driven to intelligence-driven at global scale.

Responsibilities:
Risk Strategy & Metric Ownership
- Define and own key risk metrics, including goal decomposition, trend analysis, and root-cause deep dives, and deliver actionable governance strategies with measurable outcomes.
- Continuously iterate governance strategies across scenarios such as misleading claims, vulgar or disturbing content and other content quality issues to improve ecosystem integrity and user experience.
Data-Driven Strategy Optimization
- Leverage data analysis and experimentation (A/B testing, holdout experiments, etc.) to evaluate strategy effectiveness and drive continuous optimization.
- Build and enhance data-driven decision-making frameworks to improve transparency, interpretability, and stability of governance strategies.
Intelligent Governance & System Building
- Apply machine learning models and AI Agent capabilities to improve risk detection, classification, and enforcement efficiency.
- Drive the evolution of governance systems toward automation, scalability, and intelligence, including mechanism design and process optimization.
Cross-Functional Execution & Strategy Delivery
- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Algorithm teams to translate strategies into scalable product features, rule systems, and model requirements.
- Navigate complex trade-offs between risk mitigation, advertiser experience, and platform growth, ensuring optimal overall business outcomes.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in risk control, Trust & Safety, advertising governance, or advertising strategy roles, with proven ownership of key business metrics in complex environments.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL; experience in building metric systems, performing root-cause analysis, and conducting experiment-based evaluations (A/B testing, holdout, etc.).
- Experience designing user-centric strategies and experiments, with the ability to translate user experience insights into actionable solutions.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration and execution skills, capable of driving alignment and delivery under ambiguity and conflicting priorities.
- Strong problem structuring and abstraction ability, with experience leveraging ML or automation (e.g., AI Agents) to design systematic solutions.
- High proficiency in English and Mandarin listening, speaking, reading and writing. Both English and Mandarin skill sets are required to support clients in China and to communicate with stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Deep expertise in specific risk domains such as advertising fraud, low-quality content, or adversarial ecosystem manipulation.
- Experience in ad traffic allocation and optimization.
- Experience designing or significantly upgrading complex governance systems, including metric frameworks, policy architectures, or end-to-end governance processes (risk detection → strategy/rule design → deployment → monitoring → systemization).
- Hands-on or exploratory experience applying AI technologies (LLMs, AI Agents) in content understanding, risk detection, or automated governance systems.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​

Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

jobs.title: Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis Australia Pty Ltd (SPA Australia) provides senior decision makers within the Australian Department of Defence with timely and objective assessments affecting their capability employment and investment strategies. Our team of former military professionals and operations research analysts integrate military expertise with advanced analytic methods including force generation modelling, agent based tactical simulations, and operational mission analyses to deliver trusted decision support that directly contributes to national security outcomes.

Together with SPA Australia, our AUKUS, Submarines, and Industrial Base Group (ASIG) provides timely, objective, analytic assessments that integrate technical, operational, programmatic, policy and business analysis to NAVSEA Team Submarine program offices and key stakeholders surrounding submarine platform construction. Team Submarine unifies submarine platform procurement activities, which includes the Columbia class SSBN program (a Major Defense Acquisition Program and the US Navy’s top acquisition priority), the Virginia class SSN program and the new SSN X program (developing the next generation attack submarine), to bring improved capabilities to our undersea forces. Analysts and Engineers supporting Team Submarine will continue SPA’s decades of support to the SSBN force, as well as supporting oversight of cutting edge attack submarine construction, assisting in developing the design requirements for the SSN platform of the future, and helping plan and execute new and innovative strategies to strengthen the critical submarine shipbuilding industrial base. These are high profile, major acquisition and manufacturing programs of significant importance to the future capabilities of the US Navy in an era of renewed strategic competition.

The AUKUS COMSUBFOR team within ASIG is charged with delivering high quality, timely tracking, analysis and policy solutions to a variety of challenging problems in the man/train/equip (raise/train/sustain) space. We work in a dynamic environment with new information and bureaucratic realities often forcing adjustments in approach and priorities. Current chartered lines of effort include workforce modelling and future workforce development, policy development, training strategy implementation, knowledge transfer, and operational process development.

Overview

We are seeking a high performing Analyst to join a growing Australia based team supporting one of the most significant Defence capability initiatives in Australia.

Working within a multinational AUKUS environment, you will contribute to the development and transition of workforce and training solutions, initially aligned to U.S. Navy training systems and evolving to incorporate U.K. Royal Navy training frameworks. This is a unique opportunity to work on complex, nationally significant programs that will help shape Australia's future Defence capabilities. MC

Responsibilities

As a trusted member of the project team, you will work closely with Defence, government, and industry stakeholders, producing high quality analysis, reports, briefings, and recommendations that inform senior decision makers. This role is ideally suited to someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working within multidisciplinary teams, and contributing to meaningful national outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Support workforce planning, modelling, and organisational design activities that enable Defence capability outcomes.
Analyse training systems, workforce requirements, and workforce readiness challenges to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Collect, analyse, and interpret qualitative and quantitative data to support evidence based recommendations.
Develop reports, executive briefings, presentations, and other professional documentation for senior stakeholders.
Facilitate workshops, interviews, and stakeholder engagement activities across Defence, government, and industry organisations.
Contribute to the design and implementation of workforce and training solutions aligned with Defence objectives.
Support project planning, risk management, and delivery activities within a complex stakeholder environment.
Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and multinational teams, both virtually and in person, to achieve program outcomes.

We are looking for a motivated and mission focused professional with the following attributes:

Experience in workforce planning, organisational design, training analysis, operational analysis or a related discipline.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, including the ability to work through complex issues and competing stakeholder requirements.
Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing professional reports, briefings, and recommendations.
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders and subject matter experts.
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within high performing teams.
A genuine interest in Defence capability development, workforce transformation, and major national programs.

Qualifications

Essential Requirements:

Ability to work on site in Canberra, ACT, including full time attendance where required by client needs.

The Campus Security Manager is the senior on-site security leader responsible for all security operations at a designated data center campus. This salaried, client-facing role partners closely with the District Account Manager to ensure service-level expectations are consistently met across the campus portfolio, while directly supervising Campus Supervisors to maintain staffing coverage, operational continuity, and adherence to site procedures. Serving as a primary liaison between the client and the security program, the Campus Security Manager is accountable for performance metrics, quality of service delivery, field compliance with policies and post orders, and the accurate, timely execution of all post-level responsibilities. What You'll Do
