jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, this role has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

As a Senior Analyst on the team, you will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams end to end. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures the numbers tie out: reconciling card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, against our internal payment and ledger data. You will translate ambiguous reconciliation and reporting needs into concrete metrics, controls, and automated solutions, drive discrepancies to root cause and resolution, and directly influence the team's roadmap and the priorities of our finance, accounting, and engineering partners. Our mantra: all funds in the right place, at the right time, for the right purpose.

You Will

Independently prioritize, design, develop, and deploy end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions: matching logic, break dashboards, exception queues, settlement summaries, and standardized journals that feed downstream accounting, audit, and regulatory processes.
Own time-sensitive daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data, including full ownership of discrepancy management from detection through root cause, corrective action, and control improvement.
Translate ambiguous business, finance, and regulatory needs into concrete measurement systems: define and roll out key metrics for the reconciliation and reporting domain (match rates, break aging, time-to-resolution, funding compliance, reporting SLAs) and ensure stakeholders interpret them in the correct context.
Serve as the subject matter expert on settlement, funding, and money-movement flows; field questions on transaction lifecycles, data models, and the reconciliation tech stack from stakeholders and leadership.
Own the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting using best practices, navigating new and unfamiliar datasets to answer complex questions about the flow of funds.
Work independently or partner with data engineering to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain the datasets and pipelines that power reconciliation and reporting, making sound trade-offs between accuracy, implementation effort, and complexity.
Proactively identify control gaps, revenue leakage, manual toil, and upstream data-quality issues; drive the automation and process improvements that fix them, and monitor daily settlement and banking activity for irregularities.
Own relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Compliance; directly influence the priorities, decisions, and roadmap of the team and its partners.
Lead month-end close support for the domain: reconciliation reporting, standardized summaries, and audit-ready documentation, including supporting internal and external audits.
Define business requirements and test plans for system changes, validate new processes and reconciliation capabilities before deployment, and partner with Engineering and Data teams to resolve bugs and ship enhancements.
Help onboard and mentor other analysts, including reviewing code and evangelizing reconciliation and reporting best practices.
Apply an AI-first mindset to improve the speed, quality, and insight of analytical work, and guide responsible AI use on the team.

You Have

5+ years of related experience in reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, accounting, or finance analytics with a Bachelor's degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative field, or similar); or 3+ years with a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.
Expert-level SQL, including owning the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting, and the ability to navigate new datasets and answer complex questions independently.
Demonstrated experience independently owning reconciliation, settlement, or financial reporting workstreams end to end, including defining metrics and driving them to adoption.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry concepts, and the mechanics of money movement, with the judgment to question the correctness and completeness of financial data.
Experience partnering with data engineering (or working independently) to design, build, validate, and maintain data pipelines, with the ability to make sound technical trade-offs.
Advanced Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables) and experience with reconciliation tooling and banking portals.
Excellent communication skills: able to own senior stakeholder relationships, present findings and recommendations, and drive clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.
Track record of proactively identifying and delivering process improvements and automation in a deadline-driven, high-accuracy environment.

Preferred Experience

Deep experience with card-network reconciliation and settlement (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including network settlement, clearing, and report file formats.
Strong familiarity with funds-transfer processes and rails (ACH, wire, SWIFT, RTP/FedNow) and the payments ecosystem: merchants, acquirers, issuers, processors, and program banks.
Scripting skills (Python or similar) for data analysis and process automation.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

The role is responsible for supporting the department’s transition from traditional reconciliation operations to a more technology-enabled, multi-skilled operating model. The successful candidate will lead and support end-to-end reconciliation, automation and AI enablement initiatives across the Bank, with a strong focus on SmartStream TLM configuration, matching rule optimisation, testing, process redesign, stakeholder engagement and controlled implementation.

As the reconciliation function evolves, the role will be expected to embrace AI, automation and data-driven ways of working while maintaining strong governance, risk management and operational control standards. The candidate will work with business stakeholders, Technology teams and vendors to gather requirements, prepare URS, BRD and FSD documentation, perform SIT/UAT and parallel run testing, support production rollout, and maintain both traditional reconciliation configurations and future AI model capabilities within TLM.

The role also supports end-to-end risk, governance and control matters, including adherence to Group policies, third-party/vendor risk oversight, documentation, audit readiness and transformation programmes across the department.

The candidate is expected to champion change, challenge legacy processes and help build sustainable capabilities in reconciliation configuration, AI model monitoring, continuous model training, automation, analytics and operational excellence, in alignment with OCBC’s values and risk culture.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and support end-to-end reconciliation, automation and transformation initiatives from requirement gathering through implementation, rollout and post-production stabilisation.
Engage business users to understand complete requirements and prepare User Requirement Specifications (URS), Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specifications (FSD), process flows, test plans and implementation documents.
Configure, maintain and enhance reconciliation workflows, matching rules, pass criteria, exception handling logic, user access controls and operational controls within SmartStream TLM and other reconciliation platforms.
Review and challenge existing workflows, identify manual touchpoints, control gaps and inefficiencies, and design future-state processes that are scalable, well-controlled and operationally sustainable.
Embed efficient and scalable controls that support innovation, disciplined risk management, audit traceability and sustainable operational change.
Manage complex reconciliation initiatives across SmartStream TLM, Intellimatch, DUCO or equivalent platforms, including configuration changes, regression testing, defect management and implementation governance.
Develop automation, dashboards and analytics using Power BI, Python, SQL, Power Automate and RPA tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere or Blue Prism.
Build operational dashboards and reports covering reconciliation breaks, exceptions, ageing, trends, productivity and risk indicators.
Liaise with Technology teams and external vendors for solution design, system enhancements, testing, issue resolution, upgrades and implementation delivery.
Plan and coordinate SIT, UAT, regression testing, parallel runs, production deployment, post-live validation and user readiness activities to ensure controlled implementation and minimal operational disruption.
Support the implementation, maintenance and continuous enhancement of AI model capabilities within TLM, including model inventory, training data review, continuous model retraining, monitoring, documentation, traceability and auditability across the model lifecycle.
Perform and coordinate AI model testing, validation support, monitoring, periodic review, performance assessment, issue tracking and remediation follow-up in line with applicable governance requirements.
Collaborate with AI model development teams, vendors, Risk, Compliance, Model Validation, Audit, Technology and Operations teams to strengthen governance controls, resolve issues and support audit or regulatory enquiries.
Act as a change advocate within the department by promoting adoption of AI, automation, analytics and future-ready reconciliation practices while supporting knowledge transfer and capability building across the team.

Requirements

Degree in Banking, Finance, Business, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science or related discipline.
6+ years of relevant experience in reconciliation, business analysis, system configuration, testing, automation, transformation or AI-enabled operational change within financial services.
Proven experience delivering reconciliation or operational transformation projects across business, technology and vendor teams, preferably involving SmartStream TLM or equivalent reconciliation platforms.
Strong experience in requirements gathering and preparation of URS, BRD, FSD, user stories, workflow diagrams, test cases and implementation documentation.
Ability to challenge the status quo, redesign processes, lead change and implement streamlined workflows with measurable efficiency, control and governance improvements.
Good understanding of reconciliation processes including GL, Nostro, Cash, Securities.
Hands-on experience in administration, configuration or enhancement of reconciliation platforms such as SmartStream TLM, Intellimatch, DUCO or similar solutions, including matching rules, pass logic and exception workflows.
Working knowledge of Power BI, Python, SQL, Power Automate and/or RPA technologies, with the ability to apply data analytics and automation to operational problem solving.
Experience working with vendors, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Audit and senior stakeholders.
Exposure to AI-enabled solutions, model governance, model inventory, model monitoring, continuous model training or AI testing will be an advantage.
Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and explain operational requirements clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Self-driven, detail-oriented and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, learn new technologies and operate effectively in a fast-paced transformation environment.
Strong risk and control mindset, with appreciation of documentation, audit artefacts, third-party/vendor oversight and compliance with internal policies.

Side note: This role requires 100% work in office, based at Tampines

Key Success Measures

Successful delivery of reconciliation, TLM configuration, automation and AI enablement initiatives within agreed scope, timeline and control expectations.
Clear and complete requirement, design, testing and implementation documentation with strong stakeholder alignment and audit traceability.
Improved operational efficiency through streamlined workflows and automation.
Reduction in manual effort, process risk and recurring operational issues.
Enhanced governance, transparency, traceability and audit readiness for TLM configuration, AI model inventory, monitoring and continuous model training activities.
Strong stakeholder, audit, regulatory and vendor management outcomes.

OCBC Core Values and Expected Behaviours

The role is expected to embody and promote OCBC’s core values in daily work and decision-making:

Integrity & Responsibility Uphold the highest standards of governance, accountability, and ethical conduct, ensuring strong risk and control discipline.
Forward-Looking & Innovation Challenge the status quo, embrace AI and emerging technologies, and proactively re-imagine processes to build future-ready capabilities.
Respect & Collaboration Foster strong partnerships across teams, valuing diverse perspectives and enabling effective cross-functional delivery.
Delivering Lasting Value Drive sustainable transformation outcomes that enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and create long-term value for the organisation.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

This Opportunity

Provides project management for the development, execution, management, control and monitoring of high voltage and EHV Substation and Transmission projects in support of company, regional, and national business line goals. Ensures responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, planning and project startup, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds corporate and client project excellence and delivery standards. Provides innovation, administration, and pragmatic direction to address current and future project management challenges in a rapidly changing and complex business and operations climate.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Ensure regular project reporting and updates are provided to clients, technical areas, and business unit managers, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget.

Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide “trusted advisor” service and future ready solutions for clients.

Financial Management

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Stavtar Solutions is looking for an Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery experience for our clients. You will serve as the primary point of contact from contract signing through go-live, managing timelines, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination to ensure every implementation lands on time, within scope, and aligned to the business value the client signed up for.

This role sits at the intersection of project management, client discovery, and technical delivery. It is ideal for a detail-oriented, client-facing delivery professional who can run complex SaaS implementations in fintech or enterprise environments, listening deeply, translating requirements into clear specifications, managing scope diplomatically, and keeping engineering, product, and the client moving in the same direction.

Stavtar is a SaaS company that provides business spend management and expense allocation software purpose-built for complex organizations such as alternative asset managers. Our product, StavPay, has changed the way complex businesses manage their spend and expense allocation, and Implementation Managers are how we get every new client there successfully.

Key Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Delivery

Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to customer expectations and business value.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout onboarding, managing day-to-day communication and stakeholder relationships across technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain project plans, status reports, and implementation documentation for each engagement.
Proactively identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, and scope changes early, before they turn into problems.
Run multiple concurrent implementations without letting quality or communication slip on any of them.

Client Discovery & Requirements

Lead structured discovery sessions with clients to understand workflows, goals, constraints, and pain points.
Translate ambiguous or incomplete client input into clear, actionable requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering.
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases early to avoid rework downstream, and maintain an organized, evolving requirements log aligned with what is being built.
Document business processes, data flows, and user journeys, producing diagrams (swimlanes, sequence flows) that both clients and engineers can follow.
Manage expectations and help clients prioritize needs vs. wants, pushing back diplomatically to protect scope and timeline.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work directly with Implementation Engineers to coordinate technical delivery, serving as the bridge between the client and engineering through development and deployment.
Support QA by clarifying acceptance criteria and validating that delivered functionality matches signed-off requirements and client needs.
Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to ensure smooth handoffs and aligned execution across the customer lifecycle.
Serve as the voice of the customer internally, surfacing feedback and recurring issues to the appropriate teams.

Process, Quality & Delivery Metrics

Follow and contribute to Stavtar's implementation methodology, templates, and delivery standards.
Track and report on key delivery metrics, schedule adherence, scope control, and customer satisfaction, and keep visibility into project economics and delivery tradeoffs on your engagements.
Identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes and share learnings across the team.
Utilize AI tools to automate and improve quality of client discovery process, client onboarding, and administrative tasks.

Product Feedback Loop

Identify patterns across your client deployments, recurring issues, feature gaps, and friction points, and channel them into a structured feedback loop with Product to inform the roadmap and drive scalable process improvements.

What Success Looks Like

Clients feel heard, understood, and confident throughout onboarding.
Implementations run smoothly, on schedule, and with minimal rework.
Engineering receives clean, unambiguous specs and clear direction.
Risks are surfaced and managed early, not discovered late.
Every go-live is a reference-able success the client would repeat.

Qualifications

4–7 years of experience in implementation, professional services, accounting/finance, project management, or client delivery roles within SaaS and/or fintech.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations.
Prior experience writing user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria, with the ability to map complex processes into clear specifications.
Comfortable working with technical concepts, APIs, integrations, data flows, settlement and reconciliation processes, sufficient to coordinate with engineering and guide client expectations.
Excellent communication and client-facing skills, with a track record of managing complex stakeholder relationships and presenting to both technical and executive audiences.
Ability to push back diplomatically and manage scope.
Detail-oriented, organized, and able to operate in a fast-moving startup environment.
Experience with alternative asset managers, investment management, or financial services a plus.

Tools

Requirements & project tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Smartsheet, Notion, etc.)
Diagramming tools (Lucidchart, Miro, Draw.io, etc.)
Proficiency in excel & MS Office Suite
Experience with AI & automation tools
Familiarity with SQL, data analysis/visualization tools (nice to have)

Why Join

Own high-impact onboarding for a fast-growing product used by sophisticated financial organizations.
Influence how the product and our implementation methodology evolve based on real client needs.
Build scalable frameworks for implementing future clients.
Clear path to grow into Solutions Architecture, Product, or Implementation leadership.

What You Will Be Doing

The Project Manager's (PM) role is to plan and manage construction activities from conception to completion of the project in a timely and cost-effective manner. The PM responsibilities include, but are not limited to; project planning, budget management, schedule implementation, compliance with quality standards, contract administration and safety program management. 

GENERAL INFORMATION:
- Project Manager
- Exempt position
- Worksite location at construction jobsite trailer, or main offices, depending on company needs
- Reports to executive team members (VP of Construction, VP of Operations, CEO, etc.)
- Works closely with Project Superintendent, jobsite staff, main office staff, vendors, subcontractors, design professionals and clients.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / TASKS:
- Ensure that construction activities move according to predetermined schedule, mitigating and reporting all potential delays by monitoring the progress of the construction activities on a regular basis and holding weekly status meetings with all the team members, subcontractors and clients and their consultants.
- Coordinate the efforts of all parties involved in the project, which include clients, architects, consultants, subcontractors and laborers.
- Maintain strict adherence to the budgetary guidelines, quality and safety standards.
- Daily inspection of construction site to monitor compliance with building and safety codes, and other applicable regulations.
- Study job specifications to determine appropriate construction methods.
- Identify the elements of project design and construction likely to produce constructability issues and plan coordination problems prior to beginning construction of the project. 
- Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to administrative staff, subcontractors, and clients
- Select, contract, and oversee workers who complete specific scopes of the project, such as painting or plumbing
- Prepare subcontracts and negotiate revisions, changes and additions to contractual agreements 
- Manage the budget, track project expenses and minimize exposure and risk in the project
- Collect, review and approve progress payments submitted by all subcontractors and vendors

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the Team
The USDS FUSE Intelligence program is an all-hazards team that develops products and services with action-based outcomes to reduce and identify risk to TikTok USDS JV. As a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, the candidate will be responsible for managing the triage, escalation, and reporting of threats against our US business and users that emanate from multiple sources, including internal, external and the deep and dark web.

About the Role

The candidate will effectively fuse their knowledge of the general threat landscape, the USDS business, and cyber threat intelligence sources to generate data driven, action oriented intelligence for stakeholders. The candidate will possess strong skills in research and investigative techniques to develop tailored cyber threat intelligence products . Strong candidates will also possess threat hunting and AI enabled investigations and development skills. This role will require close collaboration with internal Cyber , Financial Crimes, Payments, Legal, other USDS security teams, and various business departments.

The candidate must also demonstrate strong intelligence writing and communication skills, contribute to cross-functional teams on a global scale, engage in response actions across various security disciplines, excel in a fast-paced and ambiguous work environment, and share pertinent information as needed to support the company's critical business, market strategy, and operational infrastructure requirements.

Additionally, as a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, the candidate must be able to effectively monitor a variety of tools including SIEM, case management, premium intelligence, OSINT, and social media/ dark web intelligence sources to perform alert review, triage and escalations. The candidate should be able to enhance processes by obtaining a high level of proficiency with collection platforms, tuning alerts, and automating tasks. The candidate must also be able to create and develop threat intelligence reports which outline findings and risk to business stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
- Key contributor to threat intelligence monitoring, alert triage, escalation, and monthly reporting
- Maintain and tune data flows within a Threat Intelligence Monitoring Platform
- Develop automations to enhance intelligence collection and processing including use of AI/LLM enhancements where appropriate or possible
- Identify and further develop current intelligence sources, collection requirements, and reporting processes
- Provide timely escalations and reports with recommended mitigation strategies for business partners
- Contribute CTI intelligence resources to interdisciplinary intelligence reporting, including cyber threat intelligence, converged risk, protective intelligence, criminal intelligence, and influence operations discovery.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Cybersecurity, information security, privacy, risk, compliance, project management or like discipline from an accredited college or university or measurable knowledge / experience from proven industry, military, defense, or government operations.
- Experience with cyber threat intelligence or threat monitoring, in a security or intelligence role within a global enterprise or intelligence vendor
- Understanding of basic CTI team operations in conjunction with a SOC, Incident Response team, Red Team, Threat Hunting, Threat Detection, or other core CTI stakeholders.
- Firm grasp of CTI analytic methodologies, tooling, and approaches to conducting threat actor analysis, TTP assessments, and contributing to detection engineering processes.
- Experience authoring intelligence products, having a clear grasp of the intelligence lifecycle, and ability to integrate intelligence into security workflows.
- Familiarity with using AI for triage, research or automation.
- Ability to leverage well-honed research expertise for all-source monitoring, to include social-media and dark web sources.

Preferred Qualifications
- Familiarity with SQL and any one general purpose language for developing automation.
- Understanding or experience working with log sources from various sources, security devices, web applications and infrastructure.
- Experience with threat hunting techniques and methodologies.
- Excellent communication skills along with teamwork and collaboration abilities on global and multi-functional teams with different intelligence source groups. Experience creating and disseminating reports to multi-level audiences in a technical environment
- Knowledge of cyber intelligence data sources and platforms while Demonstrating time management and prioritization skills. Highly motivated to contribute and grow within a complex area of emerging importance in an enterprise environment

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

USDS Reasonable Accommodation

USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

Minimum of 5 years applicable industry experience working and/or providing engineering services for IOUs, IPPs, Co-Ops, Munis, etc.

Change Management
Risk Management

new_jobs.description:
As a TPM for SRE, you will partner with SRE leaders and engineers to scale the platform that underpins all of MongoDB’s cloud products. You will drive program execution, strengthen production reliability practices, and coordinate cross-functional efforts across US and EMEA teams. Success in this role means smoother launches, clearer roadmaps, stronger reliability metrics and an SRE organization that's better-equipped to deliver predictability at scale.

This role can be based out of our Dublin or Cork office or remotely in Ireland.

What You'll Do

Drive Program Planning & Execution – Define program scope, milestones, and success criteria with SRE engineers and leaders. Manage dependencies across platform teams, keep work clearly tracked in Jira, and deliver on time
Strengthen Production Reliability – Lead change management and launch readiness programs. Partner with SREs and product teams to define and operationalize SLOs/SLIs, and use incident data, metrics, and capacity signals to drive prioritization and continuous improvement
Lead Cross-Functional Coordination – Align SRE with Security, Compliance, Cloud platform, and other engineering teams. Coordinate cross-team incident response, ensure clear follow-through, and build trust as the go-to driver of complex, multi-team efforts
Build Scalable Systems & Processes – Design lightweight frameworks and communication patterns that help SRE deliver reliably at scale. Work yourself out of the "hero" role by leaving teams better-equipped to execute independently

Requirements

8+ years in technical program management, engineering management, or a comparable technical role partnering with software engineering teams
Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-team platform initiatives through ambiguity and change
Strong knowledge of production change management, software development lifecycle, and reliability metrics (SLOs, SLIs)
Skilled at shaping roadmaps and managing dependencies
Able to query and interpret metrics, logs, or other data sources to inform decisions and communicate risk
Excellent communicator—clear, concise, and calm—across engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives
Low-ego, highly collaborative, and motivated by ownership of hard problems end to end

Nice to Have

Hands-on or close-partner experience with Kubernetes, cloud networking, or observability stacks (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting)
Prior experience working with or alongside SRE teams
Background in large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform engineering
Familiarity with MongoDB Atlas or other modern cloud database platforms

Why This Role

This role puts MongoDB's values into practice. You'll own hard, ambiguous problems end to end. You'll build together with SRE, engineering, Security, and Compliance to co-create solutions that work across the organization. And you'll think big—scaling the platform and practices that power MongoDB's next phase of growth. Natural Resources National Service Line Program Manager

Shape the Future of Natural Resources Consulting

EA Engineering, Science, and Technology, Inc., PBC (EA) is seeking an accomplished environmental leader to serve as our Natural Resources National Service Line Program Manager
. This is a unique opportunity to influence the strategic direction and continued growth of one of the nation's leading environmental consulting firms while partnering with clients to solve some of today's most complex natural resource challenges.

new_jobs.description:
Position

Company : Liberty Mutual Insurance

Location : Columbus, Ohio

Posted On : 10/9/2026

Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, Boston, MA, Plano, TX, Indianapolis, IN and Columbus, OH.

You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. We will not sponsor employment visas. Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.

Job Introduction

Liberty Mutual Technology's Global Digital Services organization is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead program delivery for the AI Backbone, Liberty Mutual's shared enterprise foundation for AI. This role will focus on driving alignment, execution, and adoption across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders as the organization continues to expand and mature AI capabilities across the enterprise.

About The AI Backbone

The AI Backbone provides the shared capabilities, standards, and reusable services that enable teams across Liberty Mutual to build and deploy AI solutions consistently, securely, and efficiently. Rather than having individual teams create their own approaches to security, governance, observability, identity, and AI operations, the Backbone establishes a common foundation that accelerates delivery while reducing complexity and risk.

Supporting a broad spectrum of AI use cases, from generative AI applications to advanced agentic systems, the Backbone is designed to evolve alongside the rapidly changing AI landscape. It brings together shared technical capabilities, enterprise platforms, governance, and delivery partnerships to accelerate innovation, reduce risk, and enable AI adoption across Liberty Mutual.

The Role of this Technical Program Manager

The TPM joining this program will play a pivotal role in helping Liberty Mutual realize the full potential of AI as an enterprise capability. Working across a diverse ecosystem of technology, data, security, architecture, finance, and business stakeholders, this leader will drive alignment around shared priorities, informed decision-making, and the successful adoption of the capabilities, standards, and operating models that enable AI at scale.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence how Liberty Mutual scales and governs AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will bring clarity and momentum to a rapidly evolving landscape, helping leaders make informed decisions while aligning efforts across teams, platforms, and strategic initiatives.

Success in this role requires exceptional program leadership, strong executive presence, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with technical curiosity and is comfortable engaging leaders across engineering, security, architecture, data, and business domains to translate enterprise AI strategy into coordinated action and measurable outcomes.

About The Job

This role is responsible for coordinating the planning, governance, and execution required to advance the AI Backbone and enable consistent adoption of shared AI capabilities across Liberty Mutual. The TPM will bring together stakeholders across technology and business domains, helping leaders make informed decisions, manage dependencies, and translate strategic priorities into measurable outcomes.

Strategic Planning and Execution: Develop and own the multi-year AI Backbone roadmap (Now / Next / Later), sequencing work across shared capabilities, contributing teams, and strategic initiatives. Define target outcomes, phase milestones, and readiness criteria while adapting plans as technologies, priorities, and enterprise needs evolve. Guide the evolution of the Backbone operating model from managed reuse toward federated adoption. Maintain an integrated program plan and delivery rhythm across workstreams, actively managing dependency health, milestone slippage, and re-sequencing as conditions change.
Enterprise Leadership and Alignment: Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, and decision forums spanning Global Digital Services (GDS), Global Cyber Security (GCS), Enterprise Data & Data Science (ED&DS), Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Observability, Finance, and lighthouse delivery teams. Foster shared accountability without direct reporting authority and establish consistent planning, reporting, and governance practices across participating teams. Set the execution quality bar for program and project leads working on AI initiatives across domains, and coach them toward consistent planning, risk, and reporting practices.
Vendor Management: Coordinate strategic technology partners including AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Datadog, and Zscaler across evaluation, commitment, and scale-out decisions. Ensure build, buy, and partner strategies align with enterprise priorities, timelines, commercial objectives, and quality expectations.
Enterprise Adoption and Enablement: Drive adoption of shared AI capabilities, approved patterns, and production-readiness standards across teams with varying priorities, business needs, and risk profiles. Partner across the organization to promote consistent approaches to AI delivery while establishing governance mechanisms that support long-term adoption and scale.
Risk Management: Proactively identify systemic and cross-program risks spanning identity, governance, model risk, data access, security, and cost. Partner with GCS, ED&DS, LibertyAIR, Enterprise Architecture, and other stakeholders to address risks before they become barriers to adoption or scale. Maintain an enterprise view of risk and dependency health across the AI Backbone portfolio.
Communication: Serve as the primary author and presenter of AI Backbone updates for Tech ELT, SLT, and business leadership. Translate complex technical concepts, program progress, tradeoffs, and investment decisions into clear, decision-oriented communications and executive-level narratives, including progress-to-goal, decisions required, and risks surfaced ahead of impact.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and mature the Backbone operating model, reducing manual effort associated with onboarding, readiness assessment, governance, and reporting. Capture lessons learned and emerging best practices and incorporate them into reusable patterns, standards, and operating rhythms.

Additional Responsibilities Specific To This Role

Portfolio Governance: Design and operate the governance model for the AI Backbone, including decision frameworks, escalation paths, production-readiness criteria, ownership models, and executive scorecards. Shift governance discussions from status reporting to informed decision-making.
Dependency and Ownership Management: Build and maintain visibility into dependencies across shared capabilities, strategic AI initiatives, and underlying enterprise platforms. Maintain an inventory of AI and agentic initiatives, track maturity and readiness, and help resolve ownership ambiguity across teams and domains.
Financial and Investment Management: Partner with Technology & Enterprise Finance and Strategy & Transformation to support AI FinOps, investment planning, capacity management, funding requests, and value realization metrics. Provide leaders with the information needed to make informed investment decisions and prioritize resources effectively.
Technical Judgment and Architecture Engagement: Participate in architecture and design forums to understand tradeoffs across shared capabilities and platforms, and use that understanding to inform sequencing, readiness criteria, and risk assessment.

Scope of Ownership

Role

This position is leveled above the standard Technical Program Manager role based on enterprise scope, stakeholder altitude, and the structural nature of the decisions it drives:

Enterprise-wide scope. This role oversees a portfolio of shared capabilities, strategic AI initiatives, and the operating model that connects them, spanning multiple technology and business domains.
Strategic decisions, not execution-level tradeoffs. In partnership with leadership and product teams, this TPM influences priorities, sequencing, investment direction, escalation decisions, and enterprise readiness standards that shape how AI capabilities are delivered and adopted.
Complex problems with evolving solutions. AI technologies, operating models, and ownership boundaries continue to evolve. The role must bring structure to ambiguity, frame complex cross-organizational challenges, and guide stakeholders toward aligned decisions.
Manages by exception. Intervenes based on program-level impact rather than task-level detail, letting capability and lighthouse teams own their execution while maintaining visibility into decisions, dependencies, and risks.
Executive engagement. The role regularly advises and is accountable to Liberty Mutual's senior technology leaders and is responsible for providing clear, actionable insights that inform strategy, prioritization, and investment decisions.
Impact through influence. Success is measured by alignment across stakeholders, consistency of execution, and the overall health and adoption of the AI Backbone, measured through adoption, readiness, and stakeholder confidence metrics rather than the delivery of any single workstream.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 12+ years of technical program management, enterprise transformation, or implementation consulting experience, including 5+ years leading multi-organization, multi-year technology programs in an agile environment.
Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise platform, shared-services, or foundational capability program (e.g., cloud platform, data platform, identity, developer enablement, or AI/ML platform) where success depended on adoption by teams outside your reporting line.
Working technical fluency in modern AI and agentic architectures: LLM access and model gateways, agent runtimes and orchestration, memory and semantic layers, evaluation and observability, and identity and governance controls. Familiarity with AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, Databricks / MLflow, Snowflake, Azure Entra ID, Datadog, and MCP / A2A interoperability standards is strongly preferred.
Proven experience establishing portfolio governance decision forums, readiness criteria, RACI, escalation frameworks and executive scorecards across organizations that do not report to you.
Track record of regular, high-quality communication with C-level and ELT-level technology leadership, including structuring options and investment asks and driving decisions in contentious settings.
Experience with technology financial management: FinOps, rent / buy / build economics, business cases, capacity planning and value realization tracking.
Demonstrated leadership of organizational change in large technology organizations, moving teams from local autonomy toward shared standards while preserving delivery velocity.
Exception

The Cherng Family Center for Integrative Oncology at City of Hope is a national initiative dedicated to transforming cancer care through integrative oncology research and evidence-based therapies that combine the strengths of Western and Eastern healing practices. The Center advances a whole-person approach to cancer care through innovative research, evidence-based clinical programs, and educating and disseminating the latest advances and best practices to our patients, clinicians, and the community.

We are looking for an Education Program Manager to support the Cherng Family Center for Integrative Oncology’s education and community engagement initiatives by leading program operations, implementing strategic priorities, and ensuring measurable outcomes. Reporting to the Education Director, this role oversees key programs including the Integrative Oncology Fellowship, patient and community education, professional training, internships, educational events, and program evaluation. The position collaborates closely with clinical, research, administrative, marketing, and community partners to deliver scalable, coordinated programs aligned with Cherng Center and City of Hope goals.

As a successful candidate, you will:

Partner with Center leadership to develop, implement, and oversee strategic education initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and priorities.
Lead day-to-day management of education programs, including operations, budgets, timelines, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvement.
Direct the Integrative Oncology Fellowship and Internship Programs, managing curriculum development, rotations, assessments, milestone tracking, and scholarly activities.
Design, deliver, and evaluate education and training programs for physicians, nurses, APPs, trainees, and other healthcare professionals, collaborating with clinical and subject-matter experts.
Plan and execute educational events, grand rounds, conferences, and professional development activities, coordinating faculty, learner engagement, evaluations, and reporting.
Develop and expand evidence-based education resources for patients, caregivers, and community audiences, including digital content, print materials, and outreach initiatives.
Monitor program performance through participation metrics, outcomes, learner feedback, and data analysis, providing reports and recommendations for program enhancement.
Manage educational communications, contracts, and partnerships, coordinating with internal departments, external vendors, consultants, and community organizations to support program success.

Your qualifications should include:

Bachelors degree with 3-5 years of experience managing education, training, healthcare, academic or community-facing programs, including program planning, implementation, stakeholder coordination, outcome tracking, and process improvement. Experience working with Microsoft Suite, Redcaps, Excel, Qualtrics. Masters degree is preferred.
3 additional years of experience plus the minimum experience requirement may substitute for minimum education.
Experience managing healthcare, academic, research, or professional education programs, including fellowship, trainee, continuing education, and community engagement initiatives.
Proven ability to develop operational processes, track program outcomes and metrics, and drive continuous improvement through data-informed program evaluation.

Job purpose

The Cyber Defense Project Management team is in charge of managing and delivering the Security projects and Programs related to the Cyber Defense products.

Security Operations Center (SOC), is one of Cyber Defense products, delivers the following capabilities to the AXA entities around the globe: Security Monitoring and Detection, Security Incident Response and Threat Intelligence.

Main missions

Your Responsibilities Include

Accountable for the operational delivery of security projects and programs, ensuring they are delivered on time, on budget, and within scope.
Leading the project team, including central team, project managers within markets, and third parties.
Reviewing and negotiating project plans and schedules, maintaining full accountability for the delivery of the project within your scope.
Establishing metrics and KPIs to monitor and control the performance of the project.
Reviewing and managing the progress of projects to ensure execution is in accordance with defined plans.
Ensuring execution of the project is aligned with AXA GO project management and project lifecycle processes.
Monitoring and managing the project/program budget and expenditure to ensure the project is delivered to agreed budgetary commitments.
Identifying and tracking risks, issues, and alerts on projects and ensuring appropriate action plans are established and actively monitored.
Acting as a liaison between Cyber Defense and various technical and business communities within AXA to communicate the project status, ensure alignment with their own change activities, and promote continuous collaboration.
Communicating relevant and timely information to stakeholders to ensure visibility of progress, budget/expenditure, risks, issues, and associated with delivery.
Managing change requests (budget, planning, scope), exposing decisions to be made, proposing solutions, gaining and recording decision approvals.
Managing procurement and contract matters in conjunction with Group Procurement.

Responsibilities

In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, as a Subject Matter Expert, you will focus on Security Operations Center (SOC) related projects and initiatives. This will include:

Overseeing and providing expertise in the expansion and enhancement of our Security Operations Center and monitoring capabilities.
Managing the deployment of new security tools and technologies within the SOC environment.
Assisting AXA entities in their security transformation and usage of AXA global security products.
Driving the adoption and utilization of security solutions such as SOAR, EDR, XDR, cloud security capabilities within the SOC environment.
Automation focus:
Automated Threat Detection and Response: Implementing automated tools and processes for real-time threat detection and response, including the use of AI and machine learning to identify and mitigate security threats more efficiently.
Automated Incident Response: Developing automated incident response playbooks and workflows to streamline the response to security incidents, reducing the time to detect and respond to security events.
Automated Security Orchestration: Deploying security orchestration and automation tools to integrate and automate security processes, such as incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management.
Automated Security Monitoring: Utilizing automation to enhance security monitoring capabilities, including the automation of log analysis, anomaly detection, and security event correlation.
Automated Threat Intelligence Integration: Integrating automated threat intelligence feeds and tools to enhance the SOC's ability to proactively identify and respond to emerging threats.

Expected Skills & Experience

We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills:

Experience

Experience in project management and program management, with a focus on security projects and initiatives.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively engage with diverse technical and business communities within AXA.
Proven ability to manage change and establish processes for organizational change management to achieve required business outcomes.
Expertise in customer needs analysis and the formulation of technical requirements to meet those needs.
Extensive experience in third-party management and quality management within the context of security projects and programs.
Engineering Degree , BS/MS Business Administration, Project management, Computer Science
Project management certification (PMI, PMI-ACP, Prince 2, …)
Agile methodology (e.g. SCRUM or equivalent) is an advantage
Process improvement certification (e.g. Lean, Six Sigma) is an advantage

Technical Skills

Experience in project management 5 years
Experience in managing complex international IT projects 5 years
Experience in program management or managing multiple projects in parallel and multi-local projects
Managed budget between 2-5M €
Experience in delivering fixed price projects (preferred)
Experience in Information Security field > 1 years
Experience in Security, Network or Infrastructure solution deployment >5 years
Experience in delivering transversal projects touching multiple dimensions >5 years
Experience in managing third parties >5 years
Fluent in English is a necessity (including technical Information security English)
French is a plus

What We Offer

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

About The Entity

Lead, direct, and coordinate multi-disciplinary technical teams, being accountable to the Client for project delivery;
Manage client and stakeholder relationships to achieve desired project outcomes;
Work alongside Engineering and Design Managers to ensure the technical delivery of Rail projects;

You will work on exciting and inspiring projects for a variety of infrastructure owners, national and local governments, public and private sector clients including Network Rail, HS2, regional transport bodies, operators and contractors. Undertake work across the full project lifecycle, from early concept stage to detailed design and subsequently supporting delivery contractors on site;
Mentor others in the team, supporting their development by sharing knowledge and experience;
Provide clients with technical excellence through our delivery of projects.

Degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline and demonstrable pathway to chartership;

Understanding of client engineering assurance processes.

Experience across the full project lifecycle from initial feasibility studies to detailed design and implementation;
A track record of mentoring and developing staff.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Responsibilities

About the Tean
US Data Security (USDS) Joint Venture (JV) provides industry-leading security and privacy services to US users and supports TikTok Global. Our organization uses four principles that guide our operations. Firstly, we champion trust and transparency, leading the charge that drives customer confidence. Secondly, we are an engine of innovation. Thirdly, we drive risk-informed and empowered decision-making, giving our business leaders the information needed to make key decisions. Finally, we proactively identify and reduce risk while enabling innovative product development – to consistently build sustainable world-class security capabilities.

About the Role
As a member of the Influence Operations Intelligence & Discovery (IOID) Team, the candidate will leverage strategic geopolitical expertise and tactical knowledge of influence operations to identify trends and tradecraft of Advanced Persistent Manipulators (APMs) to drive action and response, unveil command and control (C2) elements, and document adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). The candidate must be able to use formal intelligence and incident response best practices to develop tracking and documentation of identified APMs. The candidate must have expert threat management skills including identification, prioritization, treatment, classification, and monitoring. The candidate must have excellent written and verbal communications skills for developing and briefing intelligence products for cross-functional teams and leadership as appropriate. Further, the candidate is expected to use communication skills to work closely with cross-functional partners in response to actions across a variety of security disciplines to disseminate information and reporting as appropriate in support of TikTok's critical business and operational needs.

Responsibilities:
- Possess geopolitical expertise in areas of responsibility to accurately trend IO and adversary strategic objectives
- Conduct OSINT monitoring and research to identify off-platform trends
- Uncover, record, and map adversary trends and tradecraft
- Maintain tools needed for tracking and memorialization of adversary actions and IO campaigns
- Respond to escalated events and actions when needed
- Develop intelligence reporting on hunting and investigation findings

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional experience, Proven track record of acquiring, aggregating, analyzing, and reporting on complex datasets. Expertise in open-source intelligence (OSINT) collection, tradecraft, and intelligence reporting.
- Experience designing, optimizing, and executing operational workflows within fast-paced technical environments. Ability to evaluate, prioritize, and mitigate critical business risks in real-time high-stress scenarios.
- Demonstrated ability to proactively hunt for diverse types of high-risk activity, including "unknown unknowns." Rigorous analytical and critical-thinking skills with a high degree of attention to detail.
- Deep understanding of information warfare principles and comprehensive knowledge of modern information warfare history over the past decade. Firm grasp of adversary TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures) with the ability to apply an adversarial lens to counter platform abuse.
- Hands-on experience detecting, tracking, and dissecting influence operations, disinformation, and other forms of social media manipulation. Ability to think creatively and identify previously unknown threats, vulnerabilities, and risks, while driving cross-functional stakeholder buy-in to implement strategic change.
- Measurable knowledge/experience from proven industry, military, defense, or government operations and/or bachelor’s degree in security (including cyber security), political science, and/or computer science or equivalent information security, privacy, risk, compliance, project management or similar discipline from an accredited college or university.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional experience in threat intelligence, security operations, data analysis, or a related domain
- Experience identifying, tracking, and analyzing adversary tradecraft and behavioral tactics.
- Proven track record of conducting threat actor attribution and campaign mapping. Experience translating adversary tradecraft into detection logic and developing automated detection rules.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a history of collaborating across global, multi-functional teams and intelligence partners. Experience authoring and disseminating intelligence reports tailored for both technical practitioners and leadership.
- Deep knowledge of threat intelligence platforms, data feeds, and open/closed intelligence sources.Excellent time management, prioritization, negotiation, and interpersonal skills in high-tempo environments.
- Self-motivated to drive results and scale security capabilities within a complex enterprise environment. Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large, complex data sets.

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. new_jobs.description:
Job Profile

Lab and Research Specialist 2

Job Family

Lab and Research Support

Time Type

Full time

Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date.

Minimum Qualifications

Associate's degree and one (1) year of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.

Job Description

The Center for Violence Prevention and Community Safety is seeking a Research Analyst to support applied research, public health data analysis, data reporting, and research dissemination activities. The position will play a central role in maintaining and improving research data systems, producing data reports for internal and external partners, supporting dashboard development, and helping translate complex data into accessible products for academic, practitioner, policy, and general audiences.

Under administrative direction, provides assistance in developing, maintaining, and analyzing information and information systems for decisions based on key findings of research initiatives. This function involves considerable interaction and communication with management of units throughout the university, external agencies, and public and private sector representatives. The position requires strong attention to detail, comfort working with multiple datasets, and the ability to work independently while supporting the broader research mission of the Center.

Please provide a cover letter. Applications for which the cover letter does not include this information as specified will not be considered. This position is an in-person position and may be considered for hybrid/remote work opportunities.

Salary Range:
$48, 600 - $59,378 per year; DOE

Essential Duties

Data, Reporting and Research Support:

Updates, maintains, and improves data dashboards using R and related tools.
Provides technical support for applied research projects, public health data reporting, dashboard maintenance, and data dissemination, and coordinating research-related data products, reports, and internal process improvements.
Produces reports using VDRS/SUDORS and other project-related datasets in response to internal, partner, and stakeholder requests.
Coordinates the development of data for special management, policy studies and/or research activities.
Maintains the Center’s website.
Provides bi-weekly, monthly, and quarterly departmental reports and annual progress reports for research projects.
Develops recurring and ad hoc data summaries, tables, figures, and written summaries for project teams, Center leadership, and external partners.
Analyzes developments in the industry; remains current regarding significant developments and/or initiatives occurring.
Designs, coordinates, and conducts research activities and statistical studies.
Develops and maintains databases used to generate information for management decision making and evaluation of programs.
Links, cleans, wrangles, and summarizes multiple datasets to support research, evaluation, and reporting needs.
Participates on project teams in special studies resulting in recommending solutions or alternatives.
Identifies opportunities to streamline internal processes, reduce duplication of effort, improve data workflows, and increase efficiency across Center projects.
Helps train staff in the use of departmental data processing tools.
Creates and maintains databases utilizing various computer programming languages or user-oriented software, including Python, WordPress, Microsoft Excel, R, R Quarto, and R Shiny.
Uses Microsoft Excel and R to organize, analyze, summarize, visualize, and report data.
Utilizes statistical methods to analyze management problems and/or policy implications; assists evaluators in the development of measurement tools.
Applies basic statistical and data analysis techniques to support research, evaluation, public health surveillance, and violence-prevention projects.
Performs independent studies, internet and library searches on relevant subjects.
Generates and executes ideas for data dissemination products, including briefs, dashboards, reports, data summaries, visualizations, and other products designed for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Writes about technical subject matter for academic, practitioner, policy, and general audiences.
Makes recommendations to management, public/private sector representatives, and external constituencies.
May assist university departments by providing information for operational and strategic plans, or accreditation reviews.
Establishes and maintains office-based technology systems to aid in the effective administration of projects and activities.
May perform or assist in the delivery of presentations, write articles and technical reports.

Desired Qualifications

Master's degree in a related field AND one year of experience in research, information analysis or program evaluation; OR, any equivalent combination of education and/or experience from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.
Knowledge of the principles, practices and techniques of research design, methodologies, and statistics.
Knowledge of basic statistics and data analysis
Knowledge of statistical modeling is beneficial.
Knowledge of public health, epidemiology, violence prevention, injury surveillance, or related applied research areas is beneficial.
Knowledge of state and federal government agencies related to research funding process and regulations.
Knowledge of academic research environment.
Knowledge of grant writing and grant application procedures.
Knowledge of data collection and analysis methods, techniques, procedures.
Knowledge of statistical and financial tools.
Skill in effective communication, both written and verbal.
Skill in writing about technical subject matter for academic and general audiences.
Skill in data processing systems and applications
Skill in linking, cleaning, wrangling, summarizing, and documenting multiple datasets.
Skill in preparing and summarizing data for management reports and policy decisions.
Skill in using software and tools for data analysis, especially Microsoft Excel and R.
Skill in creating tables, charts, dashboards, reports, and other data dissemination products.
Skill in facilitating research partnerships.
Ability to understand broad issues.
Ability to apply advanced knowledge of the principles, practices and methods of internet-based research.
Ability to be detail oriented, accurate, and careful when working with data, reports, and public-facing products.
Ability to learn new software, analytic techniques, datasets, and subject matter as project needs evolve.
Ability to work independently, define tasks, manage competing priorities, and move projects forward with limited supervision.
Ability to translate technical findings into clear language for researchers, practitioners, community partners, policymakers, and the public.

Working Environment

Activities are performed in an environmentally controlled office setting subject to extended periods of sitting, keyboarding and manipulating a computer mouse (75%); required to stand for varying lengths of time and walk moderate distances to perform work (10%). Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, pushing and pulling up to 25 pounds (15%).Regular activities require ability to quickly change priorities, which may include and/or are subject to resolution of conflicts. Evidence of effective communication skills.

Department Statement

Toward the goal of social embeddedness, Arizona State University established the Center for Violence Prevention and Community Safety in July 2005 to respond to the growing need of Arizona's communities to improve the public's safety and well-being. The Center for Violence Prevention and Community Safety is a research unit within the College of Public Programs at Arizona State University.

The Center's mission is to generate, share, and apply quality research and knowledge to create "best practice" standards.

The Center specifically evaluates policies and programs, analyzes and evaluates patterns and causes of violence, develops strategies and programs, develops a clearinghouse of research reports and "best practice" models, educates, trains, and provides technical assistance, and facilitates the development of and construction of databases. The Center also supports public health and violence-prevention research through data analysis, dashboard development, research reporting, and dissemination products designed to inform policy, practice, and community safety strategies.

Arizona State University is a new model for American higher education, an unprecedented combination of academic excellence, entrepreneurial energy and broad access. This New American University is a single, unified institution comprising four differentiated campuses positively impacting the economic, social, cultural and environmental health of the communities it serves. Its research is inspired by real world application blurring the boundaries that traditionally separate academic disciplines. About the team:
TikTok Business Integrity is committed to ensuring a safe, trusted, and sustainable advertising ecosystem, serving as a core enabler of TikTok's global monetization growth. The team sits within Global Monetization Product and Technology (GMPT) – Business Integrity – Governance.
We focus on advertising content quality and user experience, driving governance of risks such as misleading claims, vulgar or disturbing content, and other low-quality content. Our mission is to build a scalable, intelligent, and data-driven risk governance system that achieves the optimal balance between risk control and user/advertiser experience in a highly dynamic global environment.
As we evolve, the team is accelerating toward a more platformized, intelligent, and automated governance system, leveraging AI Agents, machine learning models, and strategy frameworks to enable scalable, global impact.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly analytical and impact-driven Ads Content Risk Strategy Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be deeply involved in safeguarding TikTok's advertising ecosystem by identifying and solving key user experience and content quality challenges through data-driven insights and strategy design.
You will operate in a highly complex and global-scale environment, making strategic trade-offs across risk control, user experience, and business growth, while continuously improving the overall health of the advertising ecosystem.
You will also contribute to building the next-generation intelligent governance system, leveraging AI, machine learning models, and automation capabilities to transform governance from experience-driven to intelligence-driven at global scale.

Risk Strategy & Metric Ownership
- Define and own key risk metrics, including goal decomposition, trend analysis, and root-cause deep dives, and deliver actionable governance strategies with measurable outcomes.
